head.title: How it works
head.lead: Most teams start work four weeks after the first call. An account manager runs each step and reports to you on Fridays.

steps.label: Week 1
steps.title: Define the roles
steps.text: We map tasks, tools, hours and language level with you, then agree on salary bands for each role.

steps.label: Week 2
steps.title: Interview a shortlist
steps.text: Recruiters send three screened candidates per role. You interview and pick the people you want.

steps.label: Week 3
steps.title: Set up and train
steps.text: We prepare laptops, secure access and office seats while your team trains the new hires on your process.

steps.label: Week 4
steps.title: Go live and review
steps.text: Your team starts on live work. The account manager tracks output and runs a 30 day review with you.

items.q: Who is the legal employer of my team?
items.a: Keystone is the employer of record in Vietnam. We handle contracts, payroll, social insurance and local tax, while your managers direct the daily work.

items.q: Can my team work US hours?
items.a: Yes. Night shifts carry a shift allowance that is included in your quote. Most support teams cover US morning and afternoon hours.

items.q: How do you protect our data?
items.a: Staff work on company laptops with disk encryption, managed antivirus and no USB storage. Access to your systems runs through your own SSO.

items.q: What if a hire does not work out?
items.a: We replace any hire who leaves or is not a fit in the first 90 days at no extra cost.
Dedicated plans need 30 days notice after a three month first term. Shared plans run month to month.
